posts.title: Got an Atari 2600
posts.description: When it comes to the computers I owned as a kid, I went from ZX Spectrums to Commodores, mostly Amigas, until Commodore went bankrupt and that was that. But I was always surrounded by friends with other systems, Amstrads and MSXes during the 8-bit era, and Atari STs during the 16-bit years.
